card.name: Linking words before a cancer indication
card.fires_on: Small linking words (for, of, with, in, after) that sit right before a named cancer type or treatment setting in oncology label text, as in combination with nivolumab or for the treatment of RCC.

modes.label: Treatment-of phrase
modes.description: The words for or of in 'for the treatment of' just before a cancer name or abbreviation such as RCC or mCRC.
modes.example: 3.9% (26/666) of patients who received YERVOY 1 mg/kg with nivolumab<< for>> the treatment of RCC or mCRC,

modes.label: Combination or trial setting
modes.description: With, in or after linking a drug to a partner drug, a disease or a trial setting.
modes.example: well tolerated, the dose may be escalated to 400 mg/m 2 /day with careful monitoring. Duration of Therapy: In clinical trials<< in>> CTCL, bexarotene
